## Description

Resolve unqualified type, view, and bundle names on every subcommand that takes those ids; ambiguous/unknown fail structurally.

## Approach

Extend `_resolve_record_type` (and view/bundle equivalents) into create/update/supersede/correct/contradict/capture/get/view/watch/handoff/brief paths. Add tests for success, ambiguous_type, and unknown_type on list and one mutator.
record.subject: short-name-resolution
